{{Quote|Sorry, the Sulfurous Moon slider is no longer available due to multiple customer complaints.|The menu at Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex" />}}
'''Sulfurous Moon sliders''' were one of the specialty [[slider]]s sold at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. At some point the sliders were removed from the menu after the diner recieved multiple complaints; however, the menu still listed it along with an apologetic message.<ref name="Dex" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Sulfurous Moon sliders were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dex" />
